name: odiff
notes: 2026-11-01: SIMD image diff CLI and Node binding; exit codes distinguish match from pixel difference, suited to golden-frame gating.
2026-11-01: Use threshold 0 with anti-aliasing off for strict determinism.
2026-11-01: Triage: assess. Report rates it a strong candidate.
2026-11-24: Guide written from partial evidence (examples/odiff-frame-diff); --aa leaves residual pixels, so combine with a pixel-count tolerance.

evidence.result: Partial: 7 of 8 predeclared check groups pass. Identical frames: exit 0 for 5 of 5, no diff written. 200-px patch: exit 22, 200 px, lines 60-69, cols 100-119, reversed 200; diff image 200 px, bbox 20x10+100+60, magick count 200. Circle 1-px AA ring: 512 px without --aa, 12 px with --aa (exit 22; predeclared exit 0 not met); solid-patch control 200 under --aa. Threshold 0: 8192 px; default match; sweep 8192, 8192, 8192, 0, 0. Two internal runs identical.
evidence.scope: Compares generated 256x144 PNG frames: identical match, exact 200-px patch and diff image, threshold sweep; --aa leaves 12 of 512 ring pixels (partial); macOS arm64

summary: SIMD-optimized image comparison CLI, also distributed as a Node package with platform binaries. It returns distinct exit statuses for differences and supports configurable thresholds, making it useful in scripted visual regression checks.
use_when: Gate exact or thresholded still-image comparisons in scripts
Use Node package distribution when integrating visual checks in JS
avoid_when: Use dssim for perceptual structural similarity scoring
Use ImageMagick compare for broad image manipulation and diff output

install.macos: cd examples/odiff-frame-diff && pnpm install (odiff-bin 4.5.0, project-local; no global install)

assessment.rationale: Official repository was reviewed, but a current release or dated maintenance signal could not be established from the sources read; retain as a candidate pending version/maintenance confirmation.
